correctness.rationale: Twelve-state automaton correctly enforces Dyck height and greedy arch index. The exact proposed rational numerator/denominator identity is proved using a degree-at-most-20 polynomial bound and exact integer-polynomial coefficient comparisons through x^20, plus direct finite word tests. Uniform simple-pole asymptotics near u=1 yield expectation slope and variance O(n); no finite-to-infinite leap is made.
